WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
    SELECT 
    fulldate,
    LastDayOfMonth,
    DEPOSITS_DATE
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
    INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
    ON LastDayOfMonth <= DEPOSITS_DATE 
    where business_day_flag='Y' and month_end='Y'
	AND fulldate between '2024-07-31' and '2024-08-31'
)
,all_cif_ytd AS
(
	SELECT
		CONCAT(CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY,format(RW.LastDayOfMonth,'MMddyyyy')) AS Id
		,EDF.CUST_ID
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY	AS	Cif
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID 
		,sum(case when EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' then coalesce(EDF.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,0) else 0 end) AS	ytdphp
		,sum(case when EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' then coalesce(EDF.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,0) else 0 end) AS	ytdnonphp
		,format(RW.LastDayOfMonth,'MM/dd/yyyy') Date
	    ,RW.FullDate
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.STRUSERFIELD8
	FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
	INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM AS CRM_ACCOUNTS
		ON RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_END_DATE
	INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
		ON RW.FullDate = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.del_flg='N'
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID='CBC01'
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA','SBA')
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = EDF.CUST_ID
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID

	GROUP BY
		CONCAT(CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY,format(RW.LastDayOfMonth,'MMddyyyy'))
		,EDF.CUST_ID
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID 
        ,format(RW.LastDayOfMonth,'MM/dd/yyyy')
		,RW.FullDate
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.STRUSERFIELD8
)	

,final_df as
(
SELECT
	 ACY.Id
	,ACY.Cif
	,max(coalesce(ACY.ytdphp,0)) AS BorrowerPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear
	,max(coalesce(ACY.ytdnonphp,0)) AS [BorrowerFcduCasaAdbCurrentYear (PHP)]
	,'PHP' AS CurrencyForBorrowerFcduCasaAdb 
	,ACY.[Date] AS [Date]
	,sum(case when ACY.Cif <> CG_REL.ORGKEY then coalesce(ACY_REL.ytdphp,0) else 0 end)  AS RelatedAccountPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear
	,sum(case when ACY.Cif <> CG_REL.ORGKEY then coalesce(ACY_REL.ytdnonphp,0) else 0 end) AS RelatedAccountFcduCasaAdbCurrentYearOriginalCurrency
	,'PHP' AS CurrencyForRelatedAccountFcduCasaAdb
	,1 ordr
FROM all_cif_ytd ACY
LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD CG
	ON  ACY.Cif = CG.ORGKEY
	AND ACY.BANK_ID = CG.BANK_ID
	AND ACY.FullDate BETWEEN CG.SCD_START_DATE AND CG.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD CG_REL
	ON  CG_REL.GROUP_ID = CG.GROUP_ID
	AND CG_REL.BANK_ID = CG.BANK_ID
	AND ACY.FullDate BETWEEN CG_REL.SCD_START_DATE AND CG_REL.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN all_cif_ytd ACY_REL
	ON  ACY_REL.Cif = CG_REL.ORGKEY
	AND ACY_REL.BANK_ID = CG_REL.BANK_ID
	AND ACY_REL.FullDate = ACY.FullDate
WHERE ACY.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
	--AND ACY.Cif IN ('R00006350','R00024392','R00096203','R00183040')
GROUP BY
	 ACY.Id
	,ACY.Cif
	,ACY.[Date]

UNION ALL

SELECT
	 '#~#'
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,null
	,2 ordr
)
SELECT
	 Id
	,Cif
	,CAST(BorrowerPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear AS NUMERIC(38,2)) AS BorrowerPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear
	,CAST(RelatedAccountPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear AS NUMERIC(38,2)) AS RelatedAccountPhpCasaAdbCurrentYear
	,CAST([BorrowerFcduCasaAdbCurrentYear (PHP)] AS NUMERIC(38,2)) AS BorrowerFcduCasaAdbCurrentYearOriginalCurrency
	,CAST(RelatedAccountFcduCasaAdbCurrentYearOriginalCurrency AS NUMERIC(38,2)) AS RelatedAccountFcduCasaAdbCurrentYearOriginalCurrency
	,[Date]
	,CurrencyForRelatedAccountFcduCasaAdb 
	,CurrencyForBorrowerFcduCasaAdb 
FROM final_df
ORDER BY ordr,cast([Date] as date) ASC
